name: @moolam/contracts
description: Moolam passport registry, verifier policy and Chainlink CRE receiver contracts.

scripts.abi: forge inspect MoolamRegistry abi --json > abi/MoolamRegistry.json && forge inspect VerifierPolicy abi --json > abi/VerifierPolicy.json && forge inspect MoolamReceiver abi --json > abi/MoolamReceiver.json && forge inspect MoolamConsent abi --json > abi/MoolamConsent.json
scripts.deploy:mainnet: forge script script/Deploy.s.sol --rpc-url monad_mainnet -n monad --gas-estimate-multiplier 110 --slow --broadcast && forge script script/Deploy.s.sol --sig "record()" --rpc-url monad_mainnet -n monad
scripts.verify:mainnet: forge verify-contract --chain-id 143 --verifier sourcify --verifier-url https://sourcify-api-monad.blockvision.org/ $POLICY src/VerifierPolicy.sol:VerifierPolicy && forge verify-contract --chain-id 143 --verifier sourcify --verifier-url https://sourcify-api-monad.blockvision.org/ $REGISTRY src/MoolamRegistry.sol:MoolamRegistry && forge verify-contract --chain-id 143 --verifier sourcify --verifier-url https://sourcify-api-monad.blockvision.org/ $RECEIVER src/MoolamReceiver.sol:MoolamReceiver
scripts.agent:register: forge script script/RegisterAgent.s.sol --rpc-url monad_mainnet -n monad --gas-estimate-multiplier 110 --broadcast && forge script script/RegisterAgent.s.sol --sig "verify()" --rpc-url monad_mainnet -n monad
scripts.prove:live: forge script script/LiveProof.s.sol --rpc-url monad_mainnet -n monad --gas-estimate-multiplier 110 --slow --broadcast && forge script script/LiveProof.s.sol --sig "links()" --rpc-url monad_mainnet -n monad
